title: Prism Evidence Bundle v2 (profile-first)
description: Canonical, pseudonymous evidence bundle signed into every glass-box credential from charter MASTER-2026-08-04 (§6) onward. PROFILE-FIRST: per-dimension scores only — the composite score and its derivation arithmetic never enter a v2 bundle. A dimension whose evidence floor was not met is null and listed in insufficientEvidence (charter §7.2/§8) — never a fabricated number. Already-issued v1 bundles are immutable and continue to verify against evidence-bundle-schema-v1.json. Serialization for hashing: recursively key-sorted JSON with no whitespace (see server/lib/credentials.js canonicalStringify). The signature is Ed25519 over the SHA-256 of that canonical form. Claim supported: the signature proves issuance and integrity of the Prism report at the stated identity-assurance level — it does not prove the candidate's underlying ability or identity beyond the recorded assurance level.

candidateId.description: Pseudonymous candidate id. The bundle NEVER carries name/email/identity fields (enforced at issuance).

calibrationRunId.description: Frozen calibration run applied; null until the first equating run exists.

isSynthetic.description: true for dummy/dev/test sessions — such credentials are demos, never certificates.

language.description: Assessment language code (en, hi-en, hi, ta).

scoringStatus.description: Non-English scoring stays provisional until the multilingual DIF study reports — rubric translation is not rubric equivalence.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension scores 0–100, or null where the evidence floor was not met (see insufficientEvidence). NO composite/overall value exists in a v2 bundle.

insufficientEvidence.description: Dimension keys reported as 'Insufficient evidence' — a first-class result, never replaced by a fabricated score (charter §7.2/§8).

reliability.description: AI panel consistency record — judge-panel agreement (method, label, agreement, panel, positionSwapDelta, flaggedForReview). Presented externally as 'AI panel consistency', never as psychometric reliability.

confidenceInterval.description: AI panel variation interval when the dual scorer produced one; null otherwise. Never fabricated.

evidence.description: Per-dimension transcript quotes. Disclosure-gated at the API (candidate's share token); always inside the signed bundle.

judgeVotes.description: Per-vote judge records with model ids (dual scorer only).

integrityEvents.description: Counts per proctoring event type; never raw payloads.

review.description: Human-review state. Detection/integrity signals are ADVISORY ONLY: they may route a session to human review; they never auto-fail a candidate. There is no machine verdict vocabulary.

version.description: Consent copy version the candidate accepted.

promptVersions.description: Versioned prompt files governing scoring at issuance (includes anchor_probes.v1 when the standardized core is live).

flagsActive.description: PRISM_* feature flags at issuance (secret-named keys excluded).

aiProvider.description: Cloud AI gateway used for scoring.

judgeModel.description: Pinned foundation-model or inference-profile ID used by the judge panel.

judgeDeployment.description: Backward-compatible alias carrying the pinned judge model ID.
